items.summary: The phrase now appears on almost every technology vendor’s website. That’s exactly why it has stopped meaning much. A database is called AI-ready because it supports vectors. A cloud platform is AI-ready because it offers foundation models. A data platform is AI-ready because it can build a RAG pipeline. An application platform is AI-ready because somebody added a copilot. These capabilities matter, but none of them answers the harder enterprise question: can the organisation safely turn its existing data, systems, processes and business rules into trusted AI-assisted or autonomous outcomes?
